propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project fields on tickets, causing sync to fail after upgrade unless migrated
Two ensure units must seed the projects mapping with legacy_default and conditionally stamp multi-project-bridge capability without writing ticket events
The seed unit writes .bridge_state/projects.json only when absent and only if the store has existing tickets, using Backend.project as the single projects entry
The capability-stamp unit adds multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities only when the mapping contains multiple projects, as a convergence backstop
Ensure units must be idempotent, write zero ticket events, and converge stores automatically at init/re-init/fsck/MCP-boot with no operator action
A two-project stamped store must still pass check_store_compat on the current binary, and one-project stores must remain usable by older binaries
